mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Require a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) when you sign in.
mfa.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.disableHint: Enter a code from your authenticator app or one of your backup codes to turn off 2FA.
mfa.backupWarning: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

Each code can be used once.

export.description: Download a copy of your account data (JSON): profile, vaults, assets, beneficiaries, executors, DMS, plan and payment history.
export.noSecrets: Contains no passwords, secret keys or encrypted asset contents.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your LegacyVault account. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.start: I want to delete my account
deleteAccount.blockedTitle: Your account cannot be deleted yet because:

blockers.VAULTS_OWNED_one: You still have {{count}} vault. Delete it first (unlocked or handed-over vaults cannot be deleted).
blockers.VAULTS_OWNED_other: You still have {{count}} vaults. Delete them first (unlocked or handed-over vaults cannot be deleted).
blockers.EXECUTOR: You are an executor for a vault owner. Ask them to revoke this role.
blockers.BENEFICIARY: You are a beneficiary of a vault. Decline it or ask the owner to remove you.
blockers.STAFF_ROLE: Admin / Legal Verifier accounts cannot delete themselves. Please contact an administrator.

consequences.signIn: You will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again.
consequences.anonymize: Your name, email, phone number, photo and 2FA are removed from the account.
consequences.keep: Payment history and system logs are kept in anonymized form as required.
consequences.noRefund: Any active VIP plan is cancelled right away and not refunded.

deleteAccount.exportFirst: Tip: download "My data" above first if you want to keep a copy.
deleteAccount.passwordHint: Signed up with Google and have no password? Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page to set one first.
deleteAccount.code: Two-step verification code or backup code
deleteAccount.done: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using LegacyVault.

errors.check: Could not check whether your account can be deleted.
